offering_description.value: Distributes electronic test equipment, electronics production supplies, maintenance and repair products, and production components to manufacturers, maintenance teams, and public agencies. It sources products from suppliers and delivers them through distribution centers, branches, and on-site inventory programs.

primary_products.value: Electronic test and measurement equipment; electronics production supplies; fasteners and industrial consumables; OEM production components; industrial tools and equipment

primary_services.value: Equipment calibration and repair; test equipment rental; vendor-managed inventory; parts kitting and assembly; supply chain management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Electronics manufacturers, industrial OEMs, maintenance teams, contractors, and repair shops; B2G: Government maintenance departments and military facilities

end_markets.value: Electronics manufacturing; industrial manufacturing; aerospace and defense; energy; transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: Test equipment, electronics supplies, maintenance consumables, and production components; service fees: Equipment calibration, repair, and other technical services; rental or leasing: Electronic test and measurement equipment
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Sources test equipment, industrial supplies, and components for manufacturers and maintenance customers; service provider: Calibrates customer equipment and manages sourced parts inventories and kits for manufacturers; OEM / manufacturer: Builds environmental test chambers for laboratories and manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Electronic test and production supplies, industrial maintenance supplies, OEM component programs, and branch-based industrial distribution

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Field and account sales teams serving manufacturers and maintenance customers; online: E-commerce sites for test equipment, electronics supplies, and industrial products; own locations: Industrial supply branches and trade counters

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA workplace safety standards and U.S. DOT hazardous materials shipping rules

notes: The current relative scale of the smaller operating lines is uncertain.
